annotations.description: Mulliganed a strong 7-card hand with two lands, excellent curve (turn 1 Mako, turn 2 Bowmasters/Nethergoyf), free cycling from Street Wraith for card advantage and synergy. This hand has everything: mana, threats, interaction, and synergy.
annotations.betterLine: Keep the 7-card hand. It has a perfect curve with Marauding Mako on turn 1, Orcish Bowmasters or Nethergoyf on turn 2, two lands including a fetchland, and Street Wraith for free cycling/card draw.

annotations.description: Put Hollow One on the bottom of the library instead of a redundant land, destroying the Turn 1 Burning Inquiry + free Hollow One combo. With Mountain + Burning Inquiry, casting Burning Inquiry discards 3 cards, reducing Hollow One's cost by 6 (making it free). This is one of the most powerful openings in the deck.
annotations.actionTaken: Bottomed Hollow One, keeping three lands
annotations.betterLine: Bottom Bloodstained Mire (or Blood Crypt), keeping the Burning Inquiry + Hollow One + Marauding Mako package with Mountain to cast Burning Inquiry turn 1 for a free 4/4 and a growing Mako.

annotations.description: Playing Blood Crypt directly instead of a Bloodstained Mire. Fetching with Mire first provides deck thinning and preserves the dual land in hand for a future turn where it could enter tapped if life is tight. The fetch can still find Blood Crypt untapped for the same color access this turn.
annotations.actionTaken: Played Blood Crypt directly from hand
annotations.betterLine: Play Bloodstained Mire, sacrifice it to fetch Blood Crypt (or a basic Mountain/Swamp) untapped, preserving the other Blood Crypt in hand for later flexibility and gaining deck thinning.

annotations.description: Playing Boseiju instead of Eldrazi Temple misses the opportunity to have 4 mana for Eldrazi spells this turn. With Eldrazi Temple, MiMo could cast Glaring Fleshraker (3 mana) and then Walking Ballista for X=0 (free colorless spell that triggers Fleshraker to create a Spawn token and deal 1 damage), generating more value this turn. Boseiju's channel ability isn't needed right now.
annotations.actionTaken: Played Boseiju, Who Endures, producing only 3 total mana (2 colorless + 1 green)
annotations.betterLine: Play Eldrazi Temple for 4 Eldrazi mana total, cast Glaring Fleshraker, then cast Walking Ballista X=0 to trigger Fleshraker (creating a Spawn token and dealing 1 damage)

annotations.description: Returned Devourer of Destiny from Ugin's Labyrinth to hand instead of tapping for {C}{C}. This degrades the Labyrinth from producing 2 mana to 1 mana per turn, and the returned Devourer costs 7 mana which is many turns away from castable. More importantly, tapping for {C}{C} plus playing Eldrazi Temple and tapping Boseiju would have provided exactly enough mana to cast Glaring Fleshraker this turn, which is a key synergy piece.
annotations.actionTaken: Activated Ugin's Labyrinth to return exiled Devourer of Destiny to hand
annotations.betterLine: Tap Ugin's Labyrinth for {C}{C}, then in postcombat main play Eldrazi Temple, tap Boseiju for {G} and Eldrazi Temple for {C}, and cast Glaring Fleshraker for {2}{C}

annotations.description: Playing Bloodstained Mire instead of Mountain costs 1 life unnecessarily. The fetchlands are better saved for later turns when specific color fixing might be needed.
annotations.actionTaken: Played Bloodstained Mire as the land drop
annotations.betterLine: Play Mountain to save 1 life and preserve fetchlands for future turns when color fixing is more relevant
